remediation.reason: Re-review failed: git replace objects or grafts substitute the bootstrap commit under the grader

findings.summary: Verified fixed: amended bootstrap, orphan root and rewritten fixture variants raise eval-history-rewritten; reset-to-bootstrap plus genuine SDD stays legitimate; no regressions.

Amending the bootstrap with the product change, resetting soft to startRevision and running `git replace <startRevision> X` before an empty-implement SDD through close is graded compliant: all grader git commands honour refs/replace (and info/grafts), so the ancestry check passes while the change sits in the replaced parent tree. Disable or reject replace objects and grafts, with a test.
A fully forged certification chain, including rewriting the agent's own post-bootstrap commits, cannot be proven locally; documented, consistent with the README authorship caveat.
